title: The Bi-UFS Positive Conjecture for algebraic semidomains
summary: A semidomain is called bi-UFS if both its additive monoid and its nonzero multiplicative monoid are unique factorization monoids. The Bi-UFS Positive Conjecture predicts that the only positive semidomain with this property is the nonnegative integers. We prove this conjecture for finitely generated algebraic positive semidomains. In the cyclic case, we show that for every positive algebraic number $α$, the semidomain $\mathbb{N}_0[α]$ is bi-UFS if and only if $α\in \mathbb{N}$, equivalently $\mathbb{N}_0[α]=\mathbb{N}_0$.
